mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.25% in a single month signals a tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate investment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% over three months signals a tightening labor market, which increases wage pressures and corporate costs, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in housing starts by more than 10% over three months signals a strengthening demand in the housing sector, which boosts economic activity and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production by more than 2% over three months signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which leads to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An always-on signal where a low federal funds rate (below 1%) suggests accommodative monetary policy, which supports equity valuations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the federal funds rate is below 1%, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a simultaneous increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) and decrease in unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 1% each over three months signals a robust demand environment, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases > 1% and UNRATE decreases > 1% in 3 months
failure_condition: If the 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.05 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A threshold-triggered signal where an increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) by more than 200,000 in a single month signals strong labor market conditions, which boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 60% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: An interaction-driven signal where a simultaneous increase in GDP (GDPC1) and decrease in the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) by more than 1% each over six months signals a favorable economic environment with strong growth and controlled inflation, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increases > 1% and CPIAUCSL decreases > 1% in 6 months
failure_condition: If the 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 50% of the instances where the trigger condition is met, or if the Rank IC for this signal remains below 0.04 over any 3-year rolling window.
